title: COTTOn RockWithYou -ORIENTAL NIGHT DREAMS-
description:
Celebrating the 35th anniversary of the COTTOn series.

Set in a magical world, a brand-new adventure for Cotton begins.

Returning from the previous title are the series protagonist, Cotton, and her companion, Silk.

They are joined by Appli from COTTOn 2, Ria inspired by Psyvariar, Fine inspired by ZANFINE, Kawase from Umihara Kawase, Luffee from Doki Doki Poyacchio, and Tacoot, the final boss from the previous game.

Newcomers include Izuna from the Izuna series and Ria3, inspired by Psyvariar 3.

In addition to 10 playable characters, unlockable characters and alternate costume variants are also available. Unlock everything to gain access to a total of 15 playable characters!

It’s not just their abilities—even the gameplay system changes from character to character!

■ Controls

1 Joystick + 4 Buttons

• Shot

• Rapid Shot

• Special 1

• Special 2

■ Diverse Characters

● Cotton

The heroine of the series.

Hold the Shot button to cast magic. In this game, magic is available right from the start!

● Silk

Cotton's trusted partner.

She moves faster than Cotton and has a smaller hitbox.

● Appli

A character introduced in COTTOn 2.

Like Cotton, she can use magic and can capture enemies with her Special Shot.

● Ria

A character inspired by Psyvariar.

Graze enemy bullets to BUZZ and power up.

● Fine

A character inspired by ZANFINE.

Features a unique time-based system.

● Kawase

The heroine of Umihara Kawase joins the battle.

Use her Special Shot lure to catch enemies and store them in her backpack.

● Luffee

The heroine of Doki Doki Poyacchio.

Specializes in powerful laser attacks.

● Tacoot

The final boss from the previous game.

Uses a detachable, controllable staff to fight with tactical precision.

● Ria3

A brand-new character inspired by Psyvariar 3.

Graze enemy bullets to BUZZ and power up.

Can detach her weapon units during a Rolling Attack.

● Izuna

Capable of close-range sword attacks.

Combines them with long-range kunai attacks for thrilling combat.

■ 16 Stages

Includes 10 stages in total: 8 main stages and 2 bonus stages.

After completing the first loop, the main stages become selectable, allowing players to progress by choosing between the "Logic" and "Law" routes.

■ Multiple Game Modes

● Story Mode

Choose from three difficulty levels.

Fully voiced event scenes before and after each stage enhance the story experience.

● Training Mode

Replay previously played stages as many times as you like while adjusting various settings.

● Leaderboards

Supports both online and offline rankings.

● Options

Configure controls, language settings, audio volume, and more.
description_short: Cotton, the magical girl shoot-'em-up heroine, is back once again! This time, the adventure leaves the Magical Kingdom behind and heads to Japan!? The original cute-girl side-scrolling shooter is back, bigger and better than ever!
